deduplication.note: Repeated daily snapshot records are counted once before window aggregation.

topic_metadata.aggregation: event interaction weight multiplied by normalized event-level topic salience
topic_metadata.legacy_fallback: events without topic_salience/topic_scores split one unit equally across their legacy topic list
topic_metadata.note: Topic prominence does not imply support, opposition or shared policy position.

relationship_metadata.observed_label_meaning: semantic direction found in explicitly classified evidence
relationship_metadata.assessed_label_meaning: dashboard/intelligence relationship label after evidence thresholds are applied
relationship_metadata.note: Interaction intensity, observed semantic signal and assessed relationship are separate measures. Evidence strength uses classified count, coverage and directional consistency.
